api_key.description: The generated API key value for the cloned key.

expiration.description: Expiration in milliseconds for the API key.

id.description: The unique ID of the cloned API key.

name.description: The name of the cloned API key.

encoded.description:
API key credentials which is the base64-encoding of
the UTF-8 representation of `id` and `api_key` joined
by a colon (`:`).
